entries.title: Worker template requires queue name
entries.root_cause: The worker deployment template requires weirWorker.queueName, but the staging values omit it. Add the queue name to the staging values.

entries.title: Ingress template requires host
entries.root_cause: The gateway ingress template requires weirGateway.host, but the staging values omit it. Add the gateway host to the staging values.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same Helm required-value error comes from the gateway ingress template and a different missing value.
